slides.headline: Zapier, Make or n8n? Start with the right one.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: The best tool is the one you will actually use.
slides.right:
Pick by your skill
and your task.
slides.right_sub: Be honest about your tech comfort.

slides.label: Tool 1
slides.title: Zapier
slides.card: Best for: simple 'when this happens, do that' flows. Free plan: yes, with limits.
slides.note: Check the free plan limits first.

slides.label: Tool 2
slides.title: Make
slides.card: Best for: flows with branches and more steps. Free plan: yes, with limits.
slides.note: Takes a bit longer to learn.

slides.label: Tool 3
slides.title: n8n
slides.card: Best for: people who want control. Free to self-host. Cloud is a trial, not free.

slides.title: Quick pick guide
items: Never automated before? Start with Zapier.
Want branches and visuals? Try Make.
Start with one simple flow first.

slides.label: Bonus
slides.title: Let AI help pick
slides.card: I do [task]. I'm [beginner/technical]. Which of Zapier, Make or n8n fits me, and why?
slides.note: Then check current plans on their sites.

slides.headline: Which one would you start with?
slides.sub: Comment Zapier, Make or n8n below.

scenes.headline: Your reviews are free market research.
scenes.sub: Let AI read them for you.

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Here are 30 customer reviews and messages. Find the top 5 complaints and the top 5 things people love. Quote one short example for each. Then tell me the 3 fixes that would matter most. Ask me if anything is unclear.

scenes.title: What you get
scenes.footer: Check the quotes against the originals.

scenes.note: Remove names and private details before you paste.
scenes.text: Send this to someone who runs a business.
